method: Second-pass review of promising ordinary GitHub results. The preset prospective labels and expected-source recall remain fixed. Additional independently useful tests from another ranking are reported here, not used to enlarge the prospective denominator after retrieval. All matches are source-based; no hardware test rerun.

cases.decision: Reuse the lane-private slot hardware control and the shared atomic refusal. This is a common fork family and the prior proof has a different acceptance domain; do not transplant on PR titles alone.

Exercise speculative resource-call, uniformity, discard, and signed-GEP negative cases from the matched optimization family. Same code family is not independent validation; the other result at rank four also has related work but different pass assignments.

Compare the explicit polling-fallback path with the genuinely functioning v0 callback implementation. A synthetic test must show a new reading after successful registration, or a cleared token after refusal; success with no delivered callbacks was the shared failure. The reference platform version must be verified separately.
Use the already merged wrapped-record script behavior as a before/after baseline, not an external transfer.
Check shared wait-budget depletion and refill before interpreting the new graphics gameplay policy. Earlier control is for compute and does not establish graphics visual-equivalence.

The D3D12 fork checks that an unrelated queue remains able to publish a completed write. The Continued PR preserves a global retirement prefix and checks against publishing ranges early. Compare both invariants before considering queue-local publication; architecture difference rules out direct patch transfer.

Both results are the exact same commit about journaling writes into private BVH arenas. The origin changes page placement and packing. Keep separate correctness/performance experiments and count the two search hits as one lineage.

It supports fixed-format MTBUF and explicitly defers destination swizzles, while the origin changes descriptor-selected format only and preserves swizzles. The same words typed load and components are not a valid transfer.
